text:
Nina Gomez: Heads-up: Prospect (FinCorp) wants to migrate from CompetitorY. They asked for a 2-week technical POC to validate prompt parity, streaming differences, and an estimate for token billing impact. Can we scope? cc @Owen Park @Maya Singh

Owen Park: I can run the tech POC. Need their sample prompt set (105), current response examples, and any custom headers/session behavior. Also confirm whether they use streaming chunked responses.

Maya Singh: Ill handle commercial. They estimate ~800k gen tokens/month. Target budget ~ $4k/mo. For a short POC, propose a $1.5k credit + per-token billing. Will that be reasonable?

Nina Gomez: I'll get prompts and their acceptance criteria. They also submitted a short security checklist: KMS, audit logs, SOC2, and data residency. @sec-bot quick summary?

sec-bot: Redwood: SOC2 Type II available, hosted with encryption-in-transit & at-rest, Private supports customer-managed KMS and VPC. Provide SOC2 link and KMS notes if needed.

Owen Park: For parity we'll run side-by-side calls and compute similarity (embedding cosine + token-level diffs). Typical smoke command below to mirror calls (they use JSON field `prompt`, we use `input`).

infra-bot: I can spin up a 2-GPU Dedicated pool for the POC and provide a staging endpoint with allowlist. Need IP ranges and the seed prompts. ETA for endpoint: tomorrow EOD.

Maya Singh: Draft POC terms: 14 days, $1.5k credit, optional Dedicated (requires PO). I'll draft the SOW and a short billing note about tokenization differences.

Owen Park: Draft acceptance criteria suggestion:
- Functional parity: intent/slot extraction match on 90%+ of seed cases or embedding cosine > 0.92
- Latency: p95 < 450ms for 128-token outputs on Dedicated at single-session load
- Billing delta: +-25% of current spend for same throughput
- No PII leaks in outputs

Maya Singh: Fine. Also add a short example showing token counts for three representative prompts so FinCorp can compare.

Nina Gomez: I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff with their infra and legal for Thu 11am ET. Can you both join?

Owen Park: Yes. Action items: Nina collects prompts & expected outputs; infra-bot to provision endpoint; Maya drafts SOW & pricing; I build the A/B harness. ETA for first pass results: 3 business days after endpoint live.

infra-bot: Confirmed: will post staging URL and allowlist instructions in this thread when ready.

Maya Singh: Sending credit approval request now. I'll include the tokenization explainer and example counts in the SOW.

Nina Gomez: Thanks team  will circulate kickoff invite and the prompt set when I have it. :thumbsup:

Owen Park: I'll add a note in the harness to normalize streaming frames and map CompetitorY's `prompt` -> `input`.

Maya Singh: One more ask from FinCorp: can we provide a short note on fallback behavior if capacity constrained? Suggest we offer automatic fallback to a smaller model with clear latency/cost tradeoffs.

Owen Park: Agreed. I'll document fallback policy and a recommended rollout plan in the POC report.

Nina Gomez: Closing loop: were good to kick as soon as infra posts endpoint.
